import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_A = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD_B = 998244353L;
    static final int maxk = 7;
    static final int base = 1000000;
    static long n_value;
    static long order_counter;
    static int total_answer;
    static int[] prefix_sum_arr = new int[maxk];
    static List<Integer>[] seqs_arr = new ArrayList[maxk];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxk; i++) {
            seqs_arr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void create_sequences(long x, int length) {
        order_counter++;
        long val = ((order_counter - x) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B;
        seqs_arr[length].add((int) val);
        prefix_sum_arr[length] = (int) ((prefix_sum_arr[length] + val) % MOD_A);
        if (length == 6) return;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            create_sequences(x * 10 + d, length + 1);
        }
    }

    static void process_value(long x) {
        if (x > n_value) return;
        if (x * base + base - 1 <= n_value && x * base * 10 > n_value) {
            long current_order = order_counter;
            for (int i = 0, mult = 1; i <= 6; i++, mult *= 10) {
                List<Integer> seq = seqs_arr[i];
                int sz = seq.size();
                int diff = (int) (((current_order - x * mult) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B);
                int pos = lowerBound(seq, (int) (MOD_B - diff));
                total_answer = (int) ((total_answer + 1L * diff * sz + prefix_sum_arr[i]) % MOD_A);
                int sub = (int) ((MOD_A - (1L * sz - pos) * MOD_A) % MOD_A);
                total_answer = (total_answer - sub + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
                order_counter += sz;
            }
            return;
        }
        order_counter++;
        total_answer = (int) ((total_answer + ((order_counter - x) % MOD_B + MOD_B) % MOD_B) % MOD_A);
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            process_value(x * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n_value = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        order_counter = 0;
        create_sequences(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(seqs_arr[i]);
        }
        order_counter = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            process_value(i);
        }
        System.out.println(total_answer);
    }
}
